title: Car Fleet
summary: Given positions and speeds of n cars, determine the number of car fleets that will reach the target mile.
statement: Given positions and speeds of n cars, determine the number of car fleets that will reach the target mile. Cars cannot overtake but can join a fleet at the slower car's speed. A fleet's speed is the minimum of its members. If a car catches up to a fleet at the target, it joins the fleet.
constraints: Cars drive toward target without passing; catching a fleet joins it at the slower speed.
Return the number of fleets arriving at target.
hints: Scanning from nearest to target, a car joins the fleet ahead exactly when its arrival time is no later.
Sort positions descending and keep increasing fleet arrival times.
Compute time=(target-position)/speed; append only if time exceeds last fleet time.
A later arrival cannot catch the fleet ahead and starts a new fleet; an earlier/equal arrival merges.
editorial: A later arrival cannot catch the fleet ahead and starts a new fleet; an earlier/equal arrival merges.

tests.explanation: Processing from nearest to target groups the cars into three fleets.
